_comment: Parity cases for lib/text-index.mjs. Both bundles that carry the module run these and must
produce the expected JSON byte for byte. `source` names the corpus file a case is a
BYTE-IDENTICAL copy of (selftest enforces it); a case with no source is synthetic.
Regenerate expected output with: node tests/text-index-fixtures.mjs --update  (review the diff).

cases.name: rivers.md
cases.why: Every Markdown construct the masker knows, plus abbreviations, initials, an ellipsis, a decimal-free number, two date forms and three definition patterns.

cases.name: letter.txt
cases.why: Plain hard-wrapped prose with names, dates and book titles; no Markdown at all.

cases.name: post.txt
cases.why: Frontmatter, bare URLs, no ATX headings — the shape a blog export takes.
